findings.section: Methods / Palmer comparison and model transfer / final sentence
findings.finding: The sentence points to Supplement S6 for Palmer extraction, provenance and reproducibility records, but S6 currently describes the earlier niche_multiscale_v1 and diet_niche_scenarios_v1 validations only. The main availability section does contain a Palmer report link, so this does not invalidate evidence or numerical results.
findings.fix: Replace the parenthetical Supplement S6 citation with explicit links to ../../work/palmer_signy_diet_external_v1/sources/source_notes.md, ../../work/palmer_signy_diet_external_v1/DESIGN.md and ../palmer_signy_diet_external_v1/REPORT_JA.md; alternatively add those Palmer-specific records to S6.
findings.resolution: Root added a Palmer-specific provenance paragraph to Supplement S6. Independently reread that paragraph and verified all three linked local files exist. Main manuscript citation to S6 is now appropriate.

checks.full_text_comparison: Main and Supplement S1-S8 read against Japanese originals; no consequential mistranslation or unsupported scientific extension found.
checks.cohort_and_replication: Nine seasons, 772 valid stomachs, 349/350/73 species counts and reuse of the 73 gentoo stomachs are explicit; Palmer 15 region-seasons / 14 distinct starting years not pooled as independent climate years.
checks.estimands_and_denominators: D uses fish+crustaceans; D_GA and c/m use four food groups; p uses valid stomach counts and recorded F>0. Correct distinctions retained.
checks.sampling_dates: Mutual-support seven-day restriction, not individual pairing or breeding-stage matching; incomplete three-species support retained.
checks.components: Recorded-positive frequency, weaker c evidence, no component-effect difference inference, exact noncausal allocation and non-product of fitted p/c versus fitted m retained.
checks.inference: Exploratory selection, limited-family permutation adjustment, year exchangeability, temporal diagnostics and cyclic-shift resolution retained.
checks.palmer: Fixed Signy intercept/slope and training-mean comparator; worse transfer error even in support; no test of biological regional effect difference; counts discrepancy and rounded aggregates retained.
checks.scenarios: All 12 conditions retained with one withheld; seven fully supported annual conditions and four supported means with unsupported years retained; BCC historical floor, conditional mean-SIC estimand and coefficient-only uncertainty retained.
checks.additional_manual_numeric_checks: S4 exact extremes and p values, S5 slope allocations, Palmer effects/MAEs, component effect sizes/temporal diagnostics, baseline fits/non-product and shape-sensitivity extrema match saved JSON summaries.
checks.references: All nine reference identities, author initials, titles, years, journals/datasets, page spans and DOI targets match REFERENCES_VERIFIED.md and references.json; existing attributed claims remain within verified source scope.
checks.figure_captions: All six original figure paths preserved; caption panel definitions, units, uncertainty and interpretation match Japanese counterparts and source analyses.
checks.local_links: All local Markdown link targets still resolve after final additions.

changes_made: Only this REVIEW.json was written; no manuscript, source analysis, model or figure edits.
final_revision_scope: Final whole-file hashes include the subsequent S9/Table S8/official CMIP6 citation additions, which remain outside this review. The added S6 Palmer paragraph and retained S1-S8 scientific content are within scope. No new model fitting or analysis tests.
